description: I believe the most important thing a leader must do is listen. And, this is the big thing that is missing in Washington today. That's why our campaign is driven by you talking, telling me what's important to you and your family; me listening, waking up each day thinking about what you say is important to your family and your community; and you and I working together to move Mississippi forward.

title: Blog | Ty for Mississippi
